answer: My pick is proof of unique smartwatch sleep-stage pattern with wearable attestation. A wearable signs a month of sleep-stage patterns unique to the wearer's physiology. A farm needs one worn device with one real sleeper per copy, and a thousand identical sleep curves are one person, not a crowd. A single agent treats the dawn as a one-off; a farm treats the dune as a recurring tax on every identity it spins up, so the timber it can pocket per epoch is whatever is left after paying that tax a thousand times.
